7084-8095-8338.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2226-4415-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4415-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4241-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4241-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4241-4828-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Karn.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

2023-3480-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1263-2060-6495-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-6495-6701.notes:
This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3756-3967-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Boommobile that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, which is a Dwarf due to Arcane Adaptation.
Magda triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

1116-1263-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1580-2301-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-5645.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Stenn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Stenn.
Repeat.

4396-4871-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4396-4871-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.

When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

1669-3293-5721-6664.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
1669-3293-5721-6664.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
1669-3293-5721-6664.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shifting Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

Repeat.

38-2173-4446-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
38-2173-4446-5220.description:

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.

Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1168-1479-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1168-1479-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Toggo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Your life total is at least 2.

325-2498-4444-6282.description:

Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat.

Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Conscripts trigger, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a token.
Resolve the Felothar trigger, causing you to sacrifice a nonland permanent and put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Felothar.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
1409-2060-3169-4929-6457.notes: The combo does not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Felothar or Crystalline Crawler.

Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.

Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.

1789-3967-4875-5649.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-3967-4875-5649.description:

Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Warden of the Eye, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Warden of the Eye's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Warden of the Eye from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping Experiment Kraj.

You may tap an additional land each cycle to get infinite mana, and you may then use Experiment Kraj's ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

Resolve the second Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.

Resolve the Mindless Automaton ability, causing you to draw a card.

Activate Xenagos's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding at least five {R/G}.

Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Witty Roastmaster, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

460-539-3291.description:

Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Angel of Fury.
Angel of Fury and Verdant Succession trigger.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Angel of Fury's power.
